question.text: For FPIs, allocation of INST trades is allowed only to:

answer.text: Related FPIs, whose details can be provided to the Clearing Corporation

explanation.text: The Logic: For FPIs, allocation of INST trades is allowed only to related FPIs, and members can provide details of related FPIs to the Clearing Corporation. The Trap: The restriction is to related FPIs specifically, not to any SEBI-registered FPI, any institutional investor, or any single FPI category. Note: Members provide the related-FPI details to the Clearing Corporation so that INST trade allocation can be made only to those related FPIs.
